legend: Petya learned a new programming language CALPAS. A program in this language always takes one non-negative integer and returns one non-negative integer as well.

In the language, there are only three commands: apply a bitwise operation AND, OR or XOR with a given constant to the current integer. A program can contain an arbitrary sequence of these operations with arbitrary constants from 0 to 1023. When the program is run, all operations are applied (in the given order) to the argument and in the end the result integer is returned.

Petya wrote a program in this language, but it turned out to be too long. Write a program in CALPAS that does the same thing as the Petya's program, and consists of no more than 5 lines. Your program should return the same integer as Petya's program for all arguments from 0 to 1023.
input: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 5·105) — the number of lines.
Next n lines contain commands. A command consists of a character that represents the operation ("&", "|" or "^" for AND, OR or XOR respectively), and the constant xi 0 ≤ xi ≤ 1023.
output: Output an integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ 5) — the length of your program.
Next k lines must contain commands in the same format as in the input.
note: You can read about bitwise operations in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation.
Let x be an input of the Petya's program. It's output is ((x&1)&3)&5 = x&(1&3&5) = x&1. So these two programs always give the same outputs.

legend.ai: Petya 学会了一门新的编程语言 CALPAS。这门语言中的程序总是接受一个非负整数，并同样返回一个非负整数。
这门语言中只有三种命令：将当前整数与给定常数进行按位与、按位或或按位异或运算。一个程序可以包含任意序列的这些操作，常数可以是从 0 到 1023 的任意值。运行程序时，会按照给定顺序对参数依次执行所有操作，最后返回所得的整数。
Petya 用这种语言编写了一个程序，但结果程序太长了。请用 CALPAS 编写一个与 Petya 的程序完成相同功能的程序，且程序不超过 5 行。对于从 0 到 1023 的所有参数，你的程序都应返回与 Petya 的程序相同的整数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 5·105），表示行数。
接下来 n 行包含若干命令。每条命令由一个表示操作的字符（"&"、"|" 或 "^" 分别表示按位与、按位或或按位异或）以及常数 xi（0 ≤ xi ≤ 1023）组成。

output.ai: 输出一个整数 k（0 ≤ k ≤ 5），表示你的程序长度。
接下来 k 行必须包含与输入中格式相同的命令。

note.ai: 你可以在 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation. 中阅读有关按位运算的内容。
设 x 是 Petya 的程序的一个输入。它的输出为 ((x&1)&3)&5 = x&(1&3&5) = x&1。因此，这两个程序总是得到相同的输出。
